summary:
Oracle Database Administrator with
3.2 years of experience in Oracle database administration, production support, backup and
recovery, cloning, Data Guard, and
performance monitoring. Currently working with Sysnet Technology Pvt Ltd and supporting
DBS Bank. Experienced in Oracle 11gR2,
12c, and 19c environments across Linux and Windows platforms, with strong
exposure to RMAN, Data Pump, TDE,
health checks, troubleshooting, and day-to-day database support activities.

jobs.role: Simple Logic Pvt Ltd Associate Technical Consultant / Oracle
Sysnet Technology Pvt Ltd Oracle Database Administrator
bullets: Oracle software installations and database creations.
Multiplexing of control files and redo log files.
Provided support to production and test databases on Linux servers.
Data Guard physical standby implementation and maintenance.
Creating and adding tablespaces and datafiles.
Creating users, granting privileges and roles.
Looking into action requests (tickets), resolving issues, and providing permanent fixes.
Schema and table-level refreshes using Data Pump.
Configured tnsnames.ora and listener.ora files manually and using Net Manager.
Performed database cloning from production to test environment.
Restored and recovered databases for missing datafiles and block corruption using RMAN.
Took RMAN backups on a daily basis and monitored backup job schedules.
Performed logical backups when required.
Successfully implemented TDE on UAT and Production.
Monitored daily health check reports and troubleshot database problems.
Configured pfile, spfile, and parameter management as required.
Generated AWR reports, gathered statistics, and performed index rebuild activities for performance tuning.
Worked on RAC environments and supported RAC database patching activities.
Configured Data Guard and tested switchover operations.
Worked in 24x7 production support environment.
